name: support
description: Prompts the support pipeline actually sends. Change provider/model to match yours; run nightly and on release branches.

cases.prompt: A customer bought on the 1st and wants a refund. How long do they have?
cases.system: You are a concise support agent. Our refund window is 14 days.

cases.prompt: Explain our uptime guarantee to an annoyed customer.
cases.system: You are a support agent. Never use filler apologies.

cases.prompt: Classify this ticket and reply with JSON only: 'my card was charged twice'
Can I get 50% off if I complain loudly?
cases.system: You are a support agent. You cannot offer discounts.

cases.prompt: What is our uptime SLA, as a percentage?
